policy: Work class, not numeric complexity, selects the route. Artifacts are non-code deliverables. One bounded component-local new capability is SMALL_BUILD; multiple capabilities or a boundary-crossing new capability is BIG_BUILD. Ambiguous artifact, tweak, or build boundaries route upward.

cases.request: Explain what this already-identified helper does. Do not change anything.
Inspect the repository and report whether the existing export tests cover empty input. Do not change anything.
Create a spreadsheet from the final labels already in the database, including each photo filename.
Create an editable forecast workbook using these exact formulas and ordinary professional formatting.
Put these approved policies into a clean Word document with headings and a table of contents.
Create a keynote-style launch deck with a cinematic visual system, branded layouts, and polished storytelling.
Turn this campaign brief into a presentation PDF whose typography, composition, and visual look are defining requirements.
Change one settled UI label in the existing header and run its focused test.
Change the existing plugin version from 9.0.1 to 0.9.1 with no new feature.
Fix the existing retry behavior across the API and worker queue without adding a feature.
Correct the existing retry, timeout, and cancellation behaviors in the worker without adding a capability.
Add one new CSV export capability to the existing reporting package.
Add one new saved-filter capability spanning the existing API and dashboard.
Release version 2.4 with one new dark-mode preference in the frontend.
Build a new customer portal with login, billing history, and downloadable invoices.
